audit_items.proof_trace: The catch block at L54-57 returns null unconditionally for all error types — including 404 (not found), 429 (rate limit), and 5xx (server/network errors) — without inspecting error.status or error.code. This collapses two semantically distinct failure modes into a single null return, breaking the property. The most impactful consequence is in memberStatus.ts:L18-27, where a null from an API error causes the endpoint to respond with is_in_server: false, falsely reporting a valid member as absent from the server.
audit_items.attack_scenario: If the Discord API becomes transiently unavailable (rate limit, network failure, or outage), calls to GET /api/member/status return is_in_server: false for legitimate members; any downstream access-control logic relying on this field would incorrectly deny or revoke access for those members.
